title: The River of His Presence
speaker: Pastor Josh Eldridge
description: What does it mean to live from a place of overflow? Pastor Josh explores the invitation of Jesus to drink deeply of the Spirit and become rivers of living water in our communities.

title: When the Fire Falls
speaker: Pastor Christine Disibio
description: The outpouring at Pentecost wasn't a one-time event — it was a pattern. Pastor Christine unpacks what it looks like to create the conditions for revival in our personal lives and as a church.

title: Rooted and Abiding
speaker: Pastor Josh Eldridge
description: Fruitfulness is not the result of effort — it's the overflow of abiding. This message explores the vine-and-branch relationship Jesus describes and what it means to remain in him daily.

title: The Weight of His Glory
speaker: Dr. Lynn Lucas
description: An encounter with God's glory changes everything. Dr. Lynn Lucas walks through Isaiah's vision and what it means when the holiness of God invades our ordinary lives.

title: Pray Until Something Happens
speaker: Pastor Josh Eldridge
description: The parable of the persistent widow is not a lesson in nagging God — it's an invitation into a life of relentless, faith-filled prayer. Pastor Josh unpacks the posture behind the petition.

title: Focused on What Matters
speaker: Pastor Josh Eldridge
description: Paul's single-minded pursuit of Christ offers a framework for a life that doesn't drift. This message calls us to the kind of focused living that produces lasting fruit.

title: Faithful in the Small Things
speaker: Pastor Christine Disibio
description: God is not impressed by scale — he is moved by faithfulness. Pastor Christine explores the theology of small things and why everyday obedience is the training ground for greater impact.

title: The Fervent Prayer
speaker: Pastor Josh Eldridge
description: Elijah was a man just like us — and his prayers moved heaven and earth. This message digs into what made his prayer effective and how we can pray with the same fervency.

title: Running the Race
speaker: Jeff Henderson
description: Guest speaker Jeff Henderson brings a message on the long obedience of faith — what it means to run with endurance, fix our eyes on Jesus, and not grow weary in the race.

title: Set Apart
speaker: Pastor Josh Eldridge
description: Living sacrifice. Renewed mind. Non-conformity to the patterns of this world. Paul's call in Romans 12 is a blueprint for a life that is fully consecrated to God.

title: The Rhythm of Rest
speaker: Pastor Christine Disibio
description: Revival doesn't come from exhaustion — it comes from rest in God. Pastor Christine unpacks the counterintuitive truth that sustainable fruitfulness flows from the rhythm of yoke-bearing with Jesus.

title: Fasting as a Lifestyle
speaker: Pastor Josh Eldridge
description: The fast God chooses is not a religious discipline — it's a posture of heart. This message explores Isaiah 58 and what it means to fast in a way that loosens chains and breaks bondage.

title: Solitude and the Saturated Soul
speaker: Pastor Josh Eldridge
description: Jesus regularly withdrew to lonely places and prayed. In a world that rewards noise, this message makes the case for solitude as one of the most radical spiritual practices available to us.

title: The Table and the Towel
speaker: Pastor Christine Disibio
description: On the night of his betrayal, Jesus took a towel and washed feet. Pastor Christine unpacks the radical servant-leadership of the upper room and what it means to pick up the towel in our own lives.

title: The Lowly Way
speaker: Pastor Josh Eldridge
description: The mind of Christ is the mind of humility. This message traces the kenosis of Philippians 2 — the self-emptying of God in Christ — and calls us into the same posture of downward mobility.

title: Pride's Long Shadow
speaker: Dr. Lynn Lucas
description: Dr. Lynn Lucas examines the anatomy of pride — how it enters quietly, grows subtly, and ultimately destroys relationships, callings, and communities — and what genuine humility looks like in its place.

title: Small and Sent
speaker: Pastor Josh Eldridge
description: God does not choose the strong to shame the weak — he chooses the weak to shame the strong. A liberating reminder that faithfulness, not impressiveness, is what God is after.

title: Bread of Life
speaker: Pastor Christine Disibio
description: Jesus doesn't just give bread — he is bread. Pastor Christine explores the I AM declaration of John 6 and what it means to be truly satisfied in Christ in a world of endless appetites.

title: Feasting on the Word
speaker: Pastor Josh Eldridge
description: The Psalmist says God's words are sweeter than honey. This message makes a case for Scripture not as religious duty but as genuine spiritual sustenance — and gives practical handles for a life saturated in God's word.

title: When the Table Is Prepared
speaker: Pastor Josh Eldridge
description: God prepares a table in the presence of our enemies — not after the battle, but in the middle of it. A word of stubborn hope for those walking through difficult seasons.

title: The Worship We Owe
speaker: Pastor Josh Eldridge
description: True worship is not what happens on Sunday morning — it's what we do with our bodies Monday through Saturday. This message reframes worship as the reasonable response to grace.

title: Spirit and Truth
speaker: Pastor Christine Disibio
description: Jesus tells the woman at the well that the Father seeks worshipers who worship in Spirit and in truth. What does it mean to bring both the heart and the mind to God?

title: A Sacrifice of Praise
speaker: Pastor Josh Eldridge
description: The sacrifice of praise is not praise when everything is good — it's praise when everything is hard. This message explores the act of offering worship even in the wilderness and what it produces in us.

title: Glory in the Ordinary
speaker: Dr. Lynn Lucas
description: Whatever you do, do it in the name of the Lord Jesus. Dr. Lynn Lucas explores the revolutionary idea that our work, our meals, our conversations — all of it — can be acts of worship.
